{{Quote|They're like the first run of TR-7 personnel carriers: forward scanners can see for fifty clicks, sides only see for two.|Jace Malcom|<ref name="TOR:StA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Securing the Advance|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
The '''TR-7 personnel carrier''' was a type of troop transport that was used by the [[Republic Army]]. The first run of the TR-7 was notorious for a scanner issue; its forward scanners had a range of fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], but its side scanners were limited to two kilometers.<ref name="TOR:StA" />
